extraction_scope: Worker-2 source-reviewed repair rebuilt activity/toxicity evidence from local XML/NXML tables, PDF text, figure captions/images, OA package members, and linked DBAASP database snapshots. The prior zero-row parser scaffold is replaced with source-supported FIC, Limpel ID, growth-inhibition, and stress-mutant assay records. Database-only MIC labels are preserved as cautions where the primary source does not tabulate the exact endpoint.

parser_quality_control.unit_policy: FIC indexes are unitless, Limpel ID values are percentage-point differences, and concentration-bearing figure records preserve uM test concentrations without mass-to-molar conversion.
